english.title: Cause use of a vehicle without an identification plate fitted

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD..), a vehicle to which regulation 67 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 applies, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not equipped with a plate which was in a conspicuous and readily accessible position affixed to a vehicle part which is not normally subject to replacement and shows clearly and indelibly the vehicle information as prescribed by regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 67 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes: Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND PLACE..) **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not fitted with a vehicle identification plate in a conspicuous and readily accessible position.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
